cleanupPolicy: Remove superseded/unapproved references from active generation sets once a replacement is approved. Before deleting files, check approved-scene dependencies and verified backup. Never treat historical approval as approval of a new candidate.
identityPolicy: Match Rexx actual head shape, facial features, hair, beard and body from original footage, not merely skin tone/color. Preserve his appearance; no ethnicity-based invented facial features.
delegationPolicy: User requests lower-cost agents for routine curation/checks. gpt-5.6-luna low selected for Rexx/Apu curation. No paid generation by curation agents.
rexxViewPolicy: Rear only. Full body looking right/left/straight; medium shoulder right/left; tight shoulder right/left. Never front facing.
deliveryPolicy: Add every completed reference set and scene correction directly to the canonical storyboard as it finishes. Label source, candidate, approved and inserted separately; only explicit owner approval marks a new reference approved.
newRenderPolicy: Generate new views from approved sources; clipped frames are supporting inputs, not finished character renders. Lower-cost reasoning worker uses built-in image tool; image tool billing is not assumed free.
